Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 Intel Core i7 RTX 4050 Gaming Laptop with 2 Years Warranty

Experience exceptional gaming performance, high-tier durability, and remarkable value with the popular Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 gaming laptop. Available at Turbo Computer, this powerful mobile computing hardware peripheral is meticulously engineered for competitive mainstream gamers, content creators, and computer science students across Egypt who require rapid execution speeds, dependable cooling architecture, and prolonged corporate multitasking efficiency. Backed by an official premium 2-Year local warranty, this device safely protects your hardware investment for long-term peace of mind.

The Lenovo LOQ 15IRX9 is driven by the high-performance Intel Core i7-13650HX processor architecture running at 2.6GHz base frequency up to advanced turbo limits, making heavy gaming workflows incredibly smooth. Graphics tracking is expertly handled by the dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 Laptop GPU, allowing you to enjoy modern competitive titles at excellent frame rates. This configuration features 16GB of system memory paired with a fast 512GB PCIe NVMe Solid State Drive for swift application loading. Games and media come alive on the 15.6-inch FHD anti-glare display layout. Housed in a stylish Luna Grey chassis, the device features a robust multi-cell battery design, advanced dual-fan thermal ventilation, and comes ready for your custom deployment as a No-OS setup.
